verdict.rationale: Undermind's deep literature review runs on its own: it plans its own searches, follows citations and stops only when new searches find nothing relevant. Users confirm these jobs take minutes to complete, so it clearly runs long autonomous research jobs. The only notification evidence is alerts for newly published relevant papers, not a notice when a submitted job finishes. Missing for 10: evidence of notifications when a research job completes, evidence that jobs keep running after the user leaves the session, documentation of job status or queueing.
